reply_text:
*One merge-blocking finding* in `leaderboard-sort` vs `main`:

*High — score precision breaks ranking* · `src/rank.js:3`
`b.score - a.score` converts decimal strings to Numbers, losing precision above 2^53—explicitly supported by the API. Confirmed: input scores `"9007199254740992"` followed by `"9007199254740993"` incorrectly rank the lower score first. `topN(entries, 1)` also returns the wrong winner.

*Recommended fix:* use the existing exact comparator: `.sort((a, b) => compareScore(b.score, a.score))`. Add regression tests for both ranking and top-N using those scores.

All 3 existing tests pass; `test/rank.test.js`’s “ranks highest score first” only covers small scores.

No other findings. No code changed.
